description:
Private push-to-talk dictation that runs entirely on your machine.

Koegaki is push-to-talk dictation for Windows. Hold a key, speak, and your words appear wherever you are typing. The speech model runs entirely on-device, so audio and text never leave your machine. No account, no cloud, no subscription. 30-day free trial, then a one-time purchase covers Mac and Windows.
- Updates now install by themselves even when Koegaki runs into trouble. An update that is waiting installs as soon as Koegaki opens, and if Koegaki ever quits on its own twice within an hour, it looks for a newer version at once, installs it when there is one, and tells you so. Check for updates is also in the tray menu.
- The first download of the speech model keeps trying through an outage, picks up where it stopped, and has a second source to fall back on.
- Koegaki never asks you to restart it. When it needs a fresh start, it restarts itself or gives you a button that does.
